idea-plugin.name: MoonlightCode Status
idea-plugin.description:
Status-bar indicators for MoonlightCode: whether anything is actually gated — hooks installed, session adopted, and the phase that decides whether the agent in front of you can write — and a Claude usage readout with the 5-hour and weekly windows, context occupancy and session uptime.

Unknown figures show as —, never as 0.

action.description: Read Claude usage and session state from MoonlightCode now
